translations.web: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.
translations.bsb: So these nations worshiped the LORD but also served their idols, and to this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their fathers did.
translations.kjv: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
translations.asv: So these nations feared Jehovah, and served their graven images; their children likewise, and their children's children, as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
